Payment Processing Service

Payment Processing is primarily a stateless orchestrator. Transaction state is owned by: - TigerBeetle (ledger entries / balances) - Account service (account metadata) - Audit service (HTTP event log)
QR codes use RSA signing (qr_private.key) No dedicated tables — uses SQLAlchemy Base (schema defined but minimal persistence).

TransferFlow (stateless) ---------------------- sender_account_id (varchar) recipient_account_id (varchar) amount (decimal) currency (varchar) narration (varchar) transaction_type (varchar: p2p/bill/salary/...) reference (varchar, UUID) tenant_id (varchar) keycloak_id (varchar)
→ Debit TigerBeetle (sender) → Credit TigerBeetle (recipient) → Emit Kafka event

QRPayment (stateless) ---------------------- qr_code (varchar, signed JWT) amount (decimal) merchant_id (varchar) customer_id (varchar) expiry (timestamp) reference (varchar)
→ RSA-signed payload → Validated at scan → Routed to transfer flow

→ Credit TigerBeetle → Emit deposit event to Kafka
